notes:
Summary: Large regional financial analytics platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for low-latency reranking + embeddings at high throughput. Primary driver is predictable unit economics for model serving (per-token) and guaranteed tail latency for customer-facing scoring. Key ask: committed GPU planning + transparent per-token unit economics under different utilization scenarios.

Recent conversations: - 2026-02-18 sync (ff_2026-02-18_7721): discussed committed vs burst model; customer insists on 99th pctl latency <= 120ms for short chat/rerank flows.
- 2026-03-01 technical deep dive (ff_2026-03-01_8049): ran initial throughput sketches; average qps target 1.2k for embedding lookups in peak windows; pref during peak: route to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted for non-sensitive traffic.

Cost modeling notes (from AE/SE call): - Baseline commit ask: 8 reserved GPUs (A100-equivalent) for 12-month term. - Utilization assumptions to model: 40%, 60%, 80% (they want charts). - Expected steady-state tokens: 1.1B tokens/month at 60% util; want per-token landed cost including infra amortization, license, support. - Customer asks for blended per-token metric and breakouts: GPU amortization, power/cooling, network, infra ops, Redwood fee. - Wants proposal that compares: reserved-only, reserved+burst, and autoscaling to hosted in overflow.

Technical constraints: - On-prem rack readiness targeted end of Q2; must validate network egress rules and KMS integration. - Data residency: model logs and user prompts must stay in-region; audit logs retention 7 years.

Quotes / direct feedback: "We need a predictable dollar/token for pricing conversations with our downstream teams — +/-10% accuracy, otherwise procurement won't greenlight."

POC plan (agreed): - 2-week bench: synthetic replay of peak traces (Mar 15-29). - Deliverables: 99th pctl latency report, throughput curve vs batch size, per-token cost sheet, fallback policy test. - Success criteria: 99th pctl <= 120ms, sustained 75% of target qps for 30m windows, unit cost within 15% of modeled mid-case.

Risks & notes: - Legal flagged SLA language around credits and remedies; awaiting Redwood legal template. - Internal infra team wants final network topology before POC can be scheduled. - Competitive pressure: they are also trialing Anthropic private inference (lower baseline price but unknown tail behavior).
requirements_summary: Workload: hybrid reranking + embeddings; bursty daily peaks with strict tail latency (99p <= 120ms). Desired commit: 8 GPUs for 12 months initially; exploring scale-to-16 in year 2. Must support VPC/private control plane and KMS integration. SLOs: uptime 99.9% for dedicated pool, regional residency. Cost modeling: want per-token unit economics at util bands 40/60/80% including amortized infra, ops, and Redwood fees; scenario compare reserved-only vs reserved+burst vs hosted overflow. Decision metrics: cost/token, latency p99, ease of rollout, SLA credits.
